Author: SunnysOfficial
Name: Venue Mapper
Description: A Dalamud plugin for discovering FFXIV venues with 2D/3D interactive markers, live events, and built-in owner tools. Your complete FFXIV venue guide.
Changelog:
## v0.5.8

- Added: "Update Venue" button in the About tab lets you re-verify and reload your venue's data for editing, in its own dedicated window separate from Owner Setup
- Added: Owner ID registration - lock editing of your venue to your own registered owner(s), with a themed verification animation
- Added: "Register my Owner ID" checkbox lets you opt in or out of locking your venue when submitting or updating it
- Added: "Copy Owner ID JSON" button in the Debug window for quickly registering as an owner
- Changed: Discord name is no longer required when updating an already-registered venue
- Added: Completely redesigned setup wizard with a step progress indicator, icon highlights, and a reordered flow (language selection now comes first and applies instantly)
- Added: After a major update, the wizard now explains why it reappeared and can't be skipped until you've clicked through it
- Added: Setup wizard now covers all current settings (notification position/duration, suppress-in-combat, event reminders, auto-pull config, and more), not just a couple of basics
- Added: Setup wizard now points venue owners toward the quick "Copy Owner ID JSON" registration path if they don't need to change anything about their venue
- Added: NSFW tag for venues, shown as a badge in the directory (SFW venues get a badge too)
- Added: "Boost currently open venues to the top" option in Settings, on by default
- Added: New in-game notification system for status updates and confirmations
- Added: Notifications for entering venues, favorites, hiding venues, teleporting, config sync and more
- Added: Optional event start reminders, off by default
- Added: Notification position, stack size and duration configurable in Settings
- Added: Notifications automatically pause during combat and duties, then resume afterward
- Added: Hide Venue option in the directory, with a shared show/hide toggle between Directory and Events tabs
- Added: A handful of hidden secrets scattered around the plugin - see if you can find them all
- Added: Default tab setting - always open to Map, Directory or Events, or remember the last used tab
- Added: Reset Window Position and Unhide All Venues buttons in Settings
- Improved: Debug window location status now distinguishes Inside / Garden / Not in Housing, with garden-aware venue matching
- Fixed: Housing district auto-detection in Owner Setup now correctly handles subdivision/private plots
- Fixed: "Update Venue" now also works while standing in your garden, not just inside the house
- Fixed: A couple of potential crashes in the Changelog and Owner Setup windows
- Fixed: About tab GitHub link pointed to the wrong repository
- Fixed: A few small internal fixes and cleanups
- Removed: Custom hotkey to open the window
